guitar.notes: James Williamson (Stooges) is known for playing a Gibson Les Paul Custom; Ron Asheton also played guitar on earlier Stooges material. Solo Iggy Pop has used various backing guitarists, so kept at medium.

tone.summary: Fuzz -> Boost (for attack) -> UK 45 Amp -> UK Vintage 4x12 Cab. Minimal effects for maximum grit and punch.

rig.name: Iggy Pop - Lust For Life - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up stray noise from aggressive fuzz and punk playing.
Provide punchy downstroke attack and initial grit before the fuzz.
blocks.gap: Using Boost instead of OD/Green OD to keep the tone raw and focused on attack, as requested.

blocks.purpose: Deliver the core raw fuzz edge and dirty garage bite.
Simulate the Marshall/Plexi bite and classic punk combo sound.
blocks.gap: The UK 45 is ideal for punchy, mid-focused British rock tones.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic British cabinet sound matching the UK 45 amp.
Enhance the bright upper mids and overall bite of the fuzz tone.
blocks.gap: Used to sculpt the specific 'bright bite' required for punk/garage sound.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for a more authentic, aggressive punk/garage bite.

proposals.recommendedAsset: Aggressive British 4x12 IR (e.g., Vox AC30 or Marshall)
proposals.reason: The current 'UK Vintage 4x12' is generic; a specific, aggressive IR will enhance the raw punk bite.
